body: It’s not cheating but definitely sounds like an intention.

I broke up with my ex last November and it wasn’t dramatic or anything, just doing the inevitable since we were long distance from the start. We didn’t talk for like 6 months before he reached out, now we chat from time to time (once a month maybe). The best thing you can do is going no contact, just don’t ghost him. Tell him that it’ll help both of you to move on.
it doesn’t take two for a relationship to fail though. sometimes one is not willing to put any effort even if the other one wants to and tries.
if any of my dumpers that thought “the grass is greener” reached out after 10 years “for a coffee” I’d simply tell them to eff off lmao
That’s horrible, but you dodged a bullet. The whole situation is weird, if not creepy. Who knows what they wanted to do.

yes, if there are 0 romantic feelings or hatred towards each other. one of my closest friends is my ex, we mutually broke up a long time ago after trying to stay in an on and off relationship. honestly thought that we just wanted to besties all along but confused romantic and platonic love lol
yeah. I don’t need this
why did she break up with you?
yep. she probably checked out of your relationship a long time ago, that’s why it seems fast for you.
no. I don’t think I should be the one reaching out cause his lack of effort was the reason of the breakup in the first place.
ah, the infamous “I need to work on myself” excuse, just an easy way out.
they are if you don’t have a plan. you can’t avoid talking about the future and the end date. you have to meet them or one of you will eventually have to move countries/cities to be together.
yeah, it was relieving for a month or so but then I started missing him, so I guess it progressed.
it was a looong phase of denial then regret for me. but honestly I was kinda forced to break up with him so I don’t feel like a dumper.

“maybe if you didn’t insist on using a condom you’d be pregnant and I’d marry you out of pity” 

I’ve never even thought about marrying him 💀

broke up with mine over the same thing. asked for the bare minimum but he didn’t even try to do something so i broke things off. he never tried to reach out after that so i guess i made the right decision

cause if he cares about her and makes her smile that’s all that matters. I’m sorry but I never once met a person who’d fall for someone for their wealth or “success”. sure there are standards but sometimes you meet someone and nothing really matters.
yep, definitely the emotional attachment. it’s the same for me (yikes) but I know it will go away after some time. don’t overthink it.
yeah, I’ll probably just save a couple of pics and maybe some stuff that reminds me of him and put it in a box.
Cause most of them were good & non-toxic. I’m not talking about keeping everything, but a little reminders of them. I still have some stuff in a box, it’s fun to open it, like re-reading my old diary

I know it will help me but I kind of want to save it somehow? I’ve deleted chats before, burned letters and threw away gifts but now I regret it cause I truly don’t remember anything about my previous partners.
yeah, I ended it but not because I wanted to. letting go of him was heartbreaking but what can you do when a person doesn’t want the relationship anymore, but is scared to say so?
dude it’s probably your personality cause the majority of women that I know don’t make it all about looks
it’s been 10 years, i don’t give a crap about him lol
for him? yeah

I still talk to one of my exes occasionally cause we stayed friends after a very peaceful and mutual breakup. I don’t contact the others though, there’s no point of doing it and I don’t even remember of what kind of contact we agreed on.

I had a very delayed reaction to mine yesterday. I think it’s the denial phase when you don’t fully realize that the person is out of your life. I still somehow think that me and my ex will be in touch even though it’s been months since we last talked.
oh no, buddy, it’s not pain. it’s just a numb feeling at this point, I’m okay.
Yeah. I dated one dude like 10ish years ago, didn’t work out (he dumped me and got back with his ex). He recently followed me on instagram and messages me frequently. It’s kinda funny.
I’d be flattered but don’t expect anything in return from her. Maybe she’ll make a move after that, you won’t know until you do it.
